This is my first report on the compound known as 2,5-Dimethoxy-4-fluoroamphetamine.
11:45am - just ingested around 24mgs of DOF an exotic phenethylamine with very few human trials. Due to the rarity of this drug I've decided to write a brief trip report to document my first trial. The compound is lab tested and due to it not being overly potent eyeballing half the vial is a safe enough practice in this case. I will take notes when the effects become present.
12:30 - Feeling definite alerts reminiscent of the comeup of other psychedelic drugs from the DOx class. A sorta warm glowing phenethylamine type high, nice energy I feel motivated to get work done around my apartment I've been putting off for a few days. Nothing in the visual department persay but it's still pretty early on.
12:45 - Deff feeling this stuff building up stronger in effect and it's nice sorta reminds me of DOiP except less speedy, have a huge smile on my face right now.
1:00 - Listening to the Grateful Dead like I do on many of my trips and the music sounds so beautiful right now. Really loving this stuff I'm at a +++ for sure the music sounds so lush and engaging. Having a very nice day indeed.
1:10 - in this dreamy psychedelic mindstate right now that is really quite lovely. Just found this Grateful Dead show I'm gonna listen to in its entirety. It took place in Veneta, Oregon in 1972.
1:50 - think that I'm at the peak of the experience and it has really surprised me in its euphoria inducing capabilities. I wasn't expecting it to feel this good its not a very visual drug I mean things have a nice soft glow to them and colors are quite vibrant but the body high is where this really shines. It's also very lucid trip mentally and I can go about any day to day obligations on this one easily. This would be a nice drug to take before a family gathering as it would be easy to play it off as tho you are sober if need be, just in an extremely good mood.
2:15 - My job just reached out to me to ask if I could come in right now and fill in for someone but I declined. Really enjoying myself today and I need this time to decompress and chill. These little psychedelic voyages of mine keep me sane and ot can't be all work and no play. That will completely burn a person out after a while. Technically I could work on this stuff easily but I just wanna relax today and I've made enough money this week considering I just got a raise a few days ago.
3:07 - Just prepared some dinner
. Just opened up a Beer I'm anticipating that blending in nicely with the DOF I'm in a very relaxed state right now.
4:30 still very much feeling the effects of the DOF the dinner I made was delicious. Wasn't able to finish all the food but I'm gonna reheat it again later on and do so. Just enjoying the day to myself to relax, think I'm gonna find some porno to watch. Something sexy and I'm gonna masrurbate, assuming this is going to enhance tactile sensations to a large degree.
6:30 Think that its starting to wear off a bit would surely say I entered into the comedown phase of the drug. It was really enjoyable just opening my second beer now and listening to some more music, good times.
8:00 - All in all I'd say that it was a highly enjoyable trip and I'm really looking forward of taking this stuff again someday. Preferably with a lady friend cuz I'm sure it could make a sensual night at home something truly epic. Still not at baseline but it has pretty much tapered off. I'd give DOF two thumbs up for sure.
[Reported Dose: "22mgs"]
